evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: The backlog provides no music/audio ingestion or catalog creation capability, so music search/discovery has no content source to fingerprint.
No story creates or updates a user profile or preferences; profile-based search cannot work without profile management.
The story requests discovery based on similar users as a capability; it does not clearly expose a missing complementary user story.
Self-contained content-similarity discovery request; no necessary missing complementary capability is evident from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: There is no story creating or enriching music metadata/image tags; the backlog only covers tags for uploaded videos.
This is a creation story for tagged video upload, and related processing/search stories exist.
Thumbnail viewing can rely on segment generation covered as a processing concern; no standalone missing story is directly necessary.
The story requests similar-video information as a capability; no missing complementary user story is clearly required.
The perceptual similarity request is self-contained as a feature; no clear missing complementary capability is evidenced.
The story requests recommendations from similar profiles; the profile gap is already exposed elsewhere and this story does not add a separate necessary missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: No story detects, geolocates, or extracts area-relevant news events; the recommendation depends on absent news-event/geolocation capability.
Person identification with related information is stated as a discrete feature; no missing complementary user story is clearly required.
Product identification is requested as a feature itself; no clear missing complementary capability is exposed.
Broadcaster logo identification is a self-contained feature request; no necessary missing complementary story identified.
Brand identification is a self-contained feature request; no necessary missing complementary story identified.
The story includes image upload and recommendation as the requested capability; no clear missing complementary story is present.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: The backlog lacks a story creating georeferenced video metadata or geotagging, so map-based discovery is missing a necessary data creation capability.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: No story transcribes or indexes content via ASR; searching content by ASR depends on absent transcript creation.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: The backlog lacks a segmentation-generation story, so validating/editing segmentation assumes a creation capability that is missing.
